ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 import * from dw::Runtime output application/json
var colombiaNow = now() >> "America/Bogota" var currentTimeMs = now() as Number {unit: "milliseconds"} var startExecutionTimeMs = vars.auditContext.startTimeMs default currentTimeMs
fun toText(value) = if (value == null) null else if (value is String) value else try( () -> write( value, (payload.^mediaType as String) default "application/json" ) ) orElse (() -> value as String)
--- {
PAYLOAD: toText(payload),
FECHA: colombiaNow as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS" },
ATTRIBUTES: if (vars.auditContext.attributes != null) write( vars.auditContext.attributes, "application/json" ) else null,
HTTPCODE: attributes.statusCode default 0,
HOST: vars.auditContext.host default null,
CORRELATIONID: vars.auditContext.correlationId default null,
APINAME: vars.auditContext.apiName default null,
PROCESSNAME: vars.auditContext.processName default null,
PATH: vars.auditContext.path default null,
HTTPMETHOD: vars.auditContext.httpMethod default null,
TIEMPO_RESPUESTA_MS: currentTimeMs - startExecutionTimeMs,
IP: vars.auditContext.ip default null }
